acceptance: The comment-policy result for a head does not change with oracle verdict timing; a test or recorded run shows it passing before SHIP.
description: On #3827 (head a20d6ebac4) CI's comment-policy job failed and passed only after a manual rerun once the oracle had SHIPped the head. A required check whose result depends on oracle timing forces manual reruns and adds a CI cycle per PR. Find why the job reads oracle state (or races it) and make it deterministic for a given head.
